_comment: The shared-brain pointer. TRACKED IN GIT, holds no secret. Fill in database_url once, for everyone, and commit it; a fresh clone then lands on the same brain. Keys starting with _comment are ignored.
_comment_database_url: Explicit libpq DSN of the shared Postgres + pgvector brain, e.g. 'host=db.example.com port=5432 dbname=loop_kb user=loop_rw sslmode=require'. Never defaulted: an empty value is an error. KB_DATABASE_URL in the environment (or kb --db) overrides it. A loopback / unix-socket host is refused unless KB_ALLOW_UNSHARED=1.
_comment_auth: auth.mode is one of: password (DSN / PGPASSWORD / ~/.pgpass, or the env var auth.password_env names, default KB_DB_PASSWORD, usually set in the secret env file) | url_env (the full DSN with its credential lives in the env var auth.env names, default KB_DATABASE_URL) | token_command (auth.command, an argv list or shell string that prints a short-lived DB token used as the password, e.g. a cloud CLI's generate-db-auth-token).
_comment_embedding: provider: openai | openai-compatible (set embedding.base_url for a self-hosted or gateway endpoint) | stub (TEST-ONLY, never for real rows). api_key_env NAMES the env var holding the key; the key itself lives in the secret env file. Changing dim means re-rendering the schema: kb schema --dim N --apply.
_comment_secret_env_file: Gitignored, per machine, next to this file: the embedding key (the variable api_key_env names) and, for auth.mode password, KB_DB_PASSWORD.
